item.text: I’ll move the plot map to a post-first-version ticket and keep a plain allocation list for the coordinator. I’ll update the coverage and acceptance criteria, then rerun the independent review because this changes ticket scope.

The plot map is now **post-first-version work**. Version 1 retains coordinator allocation controls and a plain list of plots and assignments. Its acceptance criteria exclude the map; payments and tool lending also remain deferred.

The revised inventory is **14 tickets across six milestones**, plus Storybloq’s default setup phase:

| Milestone | Tickets | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| Experience and foundation | **A:** mobile prototype without map; **B:** persistent foundation; **D:** owner checkpoint | A/B unblocked; D waits on A/B |
| Authenticated applications | **C:** email-link access and household onboarding; **E:** applications | C waits on B; E on C/D |
| Fair allocation | **F:** allocation and FIFO logic; **G:** coordinator workspace with plain list; **H:** gardener allocation view; **I:** allocation demonstration | F waits on E; G/H on F, H also on C; I on G/H |
| Problems and notifications | **J:** reporting and resolution; **K:** daily coordinator digest | J waits on B/C; K on J/C |
| First-version release | **L:** release verification; **N:** owner acceptance | L waits on G/H/K; N on L/I |
| **After first version** | **M:** coordinator’s accessible 40-plot map | G and N |

Coverage for the brief’s map requirement now points exclusively to **M**. The prototype, allocation demonstration, release checks, and first-version acceptance have all been adjusted. No first-version ticket depends on M.

The remaining package is unchanged: Plotbook using npm/TypeScript, Next.js and PostgreSQL; `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, and `REVIEW.md`; initial snapshot, handover, setup note; Git initialization and Storybloq runtime-file ignores. Household verification, configurable season/timezone settings, and email delivery remain the previously stated assumptions. A and B can begin immediately after setup.

Quality level: Full pipeline.

| Stage | Proposed command | Initial state |
|---|---|---|
| WRITE_TESTS | `npm test` | Disabled; tooling and test sources pending |
| TEST | `npm test` | Disabled; tooling and test sources pending |
| BUILD | `npm run build` | Disabled; manifest pending |
| VERIFY | `npm run dev`, readiness at `http://localhost:3000` | Disabled; server configuration pending |

Checkpoints remain ordinary tickets, without mechanically enforced owner approval. No files have been written.
